behavior.text: Courtship and social smell: Or47b pheromone receptor neurons (VA1v glomerulus) drive antennal lobe projection neurons to the lateral horn and feed the fruitless courtship system — the sensory front end of the P1 mating-drive circuit.
behavior.basis: Or47b as the male courtship pheromone ORN projecting via VA1v to higher olfactory centers is textbook Drosophila (Dweck 2015; Kohl 2013); edges below are the resolved API walk, stated as measured wiring

honest_note: Or47b grouped class-level queries truncate server-side in every form; hop 0->1 edges are from the named DownstreamClassConnectivity query (50 rows, real). Hop-1 takes the most specific member of each ontology-duplicated tier (documented above). 'fruitless expressing neuron' is broad but kept deliberately — it is the pheromone -> courtship bridge. CONVERGENCE WITH MATING: this chain MEETS the P1 chain (mating.json) at FBbt_00016687 'fruitless expressing neuron' — Or47b feeds it (tw=13133) and P1's aSP-a feeds it (tw=63139). The pheromone sense and the mating drive share a node: smell enters the courtship system here. Or88a (VA1d, FBbt_00067057) is unindexable in every query form tried (grouped label/id, named, instance enumeration, CATMAID annotation search) — server-side truncation, documented dead avenue, not faked. ppk23/ppk29 gustatory pheromone neurons have no adult FBbt class (VFB search returns only the gene + L1EM larval instances). 2026-10-15 RETRY SWEEP: Or88a (FBbt_00067057) is HEALED — the poisoned index entry now returns 129 real rows via grouped ID form. Or88a half added: VA1d uniglomerular PNs (tw=13,168/11,444 — VA1d is Or88a's glomerulus), MB-projecting PN, multiglomerular vPN type 63, lALT4, subesophageal sensory interneuron, VA1d vPN; plus shared nodes with the Or47b half (AL PN->LH, AL local, fru FBbt_00016687). The two pheromone channels converge on the same lateral-horn/fru readout — parallel pheromone lines, same courtship back-end.
